overall_reason: A release-checklist card whose title, meta, task rows and footer are all set at 12px weight 400, with task rows on drifting columns and a centred footer under left-aligned rows.

score.reason: T-SQUINT fails (only the Open project button survives the blur; the title and rows dissolve into one grey), and T-LEFT-EDGES finds three left lines and two status columns inside one card.

findings.where: card head and task rows, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: 'Release checklist' (h3), 'Due Friday · 4 tasks', 'Review copy', 'Test mobile' and '2 tasks remaining' are all 12px at weight 400; the sweep skipped flat_hierarchy because only one type role exists. In P41/03-lenses/squint/1440-00.png only the dark Open project button reads; the title has no more weight than the rows.
findings.before: Title, meta and rows at one size and weight.
findings.after: Make the title the heaviest text in the card, and set the meta and the footer count quieter than the task rows.
findings.why: The reader has to read every line to find the one that names the checklist.
findings.title: Hierarchy survives the squint

findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: 'Review copy' starts at x=413 and 'Test mobile' at x=420; their statuses start at x=493 ('Ready') and x=511 ('In review'). Each row sizes its own tracks, so neither the names nor the statuses form a column.
findings.before: Two rows, two name starts and two status starts.
findings.after: Put every row on one grid template: names on the card's left line, statuses on one track ending at the card's right line (x=663).
findings.why: Statuses that do not line up cannot be scanned down; the list reads as loose text.
findings.title: Line up columns

findings.where: footer with '2 tasks remaining' and Open project, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: '2 tasks remaining' (x=492) and the Open project button (x=495) are centred in the card, while the icon, title and rows start at x=413 and x=451.
findings.before: A centred footer under a left-aligned body.
findings.after: Put the footer on the body's axis: the count on the left line and the button on the right line, parted from the rows by a rule or 16px of space.
findings.why: Two alignment axes in a 284px card leave the action floating apart from the list it belongs to.
findings.title: One alignment axis

strengths: The icon tile and the title-and-meta pair hold together as one 38px head block.
not_investigated: 00-contract.md is absent, so no audience, visitor mode or brief overrides were read; the item is judged as the single UI composition it is (an Operate-style component).

T-FIVE-SECOND fold check, T-SCREEN-BY-SCREEN beyond the single tile, T-HEADINGS-READ, T-COMPOSITION-RUN, T-STOCK-ORDER and T-ANATOMY were not run: the artifact is one composition on one screen with no section sequence.
Colour, type sizes, contrast and copy belong to other lenses and the sweep; they are not judged here.
